root_cause.text: In net/core/skbuff.c, skb_kfree_head() inferred the original allocator from skb_end_offset and assumed end_offset == SKB_SMALL_HEAD_HEADROOM meant the skb head came from skb_small_head_cache, but KFENCE’s exact-size ksize() made kmalloc/KFENCE allocations collide with that sentinel value and be freed to the wrong slab cache.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that with KFENCE, “kfence_ksize() returns the exact requested allocation size,” so a kzalloc() request equal to SKB_SMALL_HEAD_CACHE_SIZE makes “skb_end_offset end up matching SKB_SMALL_HEAD_HEADROOM,” which “caus[es] skb_kfree_head() to incorrectly free the object to skb_small_head_cache instead of back to the original kmalloc cache”; the patch removes the conditional kmem_cache_free(...skb_small_head_cache...) and changes skb_kfree_head() to always call kfree(head).

agent_logs.evidence_points: The commit message states that with KFENCE, “kfence_ksize() returns the exact requested allocation size,” so a kzalloc() request equal to SKB_SMALL_HEAD_CACHE_SIZE makes “skb_end_offset end up matching SKB_SMALL_HEAD_HEADROOM,” which “caus[es] skb_kfree_head() to incorrectly free the object to skb_small_head_cache instead of back to the original kmalloc cache”; the patch removes the conditional kmem_cache_free(...skb_small_head_cache...) and changes skb_kfree_head() to always call kfree(head).

intent_record.intent_summary: Always free skb heads with kfree() by removing the special skb_small_head_cache deallocation path.
intent_record.what: The conditional logic in skb_kfree_head() that checked whether end_offset equals SKB_SMALL_HEAD_HEADROOM and freed head through net_hotdata.skb_small_head_cache in that case was removed, and the function now always calls kfree(head) regardless of end_offset.
intent_record.how: At runtime, skb_kfree_head() no longer frees certain skb heads via the skb_small_head_cache allocator path and instead releases all heads with kfree(), eliminating the special-case deallocation behavior tied to SKB_SMALL_HEAD_HEADROOM.

grouping_result.intent: Always free skb heads with kfree() by removing the special skb_small_head_cache deallocation path.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause: freeing skb heads based on inferred allocator/sentinel end_offset caused wrong-cache frees when KFENCE allocations matched the sentinel size. Removing the special skb_small_head_cache free path and always using kfree() eliminates that incorrect allocator inference.

candidates.rationale: This conditional embodies the flawed inference of allocator origin from end_offset. KFENCE/kmalloc allocations can have an end_offset equal to SKB_SMALL_HEAD_HEADROOM, causing misclassification.
When the flawed end_offset check matches, this frees the head to skb_small_head_cache even if it was actually allocated by kmalloc/KFENCE, causing the wrong-cache free.

vuln_statements.explanation: This is the wrong-cache free that directly triggers the vulnerability: a head allocated by kmalloc/KFENCE can be misidentified and then freed into skb_small_head_cache, leading to allocator mismatch.

This conditional is the flawed allocator-origin inference. It treats end_offset equal to SKB_SMALL_HEAD_HEADROOM as proof the head came from skb_small_head_cache, which is invalid when KFENCE/kmalloc ksize() can produce the same value.
